title: A new home for Jonaz Productions
excerpt: The Jonaz Productions website has been rebuilt as the central place for all projects, releases and announcements.
body:
The Jonaz Productions website has been rebuilt from the ground up. It is now the central place for every project, release and announcement.

- **Projects**: MLBClient, Operation Iron Veil and QuickClient each have their own page.
- **News**: development updates, release notes and announcements in one place.
- **Contact**: a contact form and links to the community.

The in-game news of QuickClient and MLBClient keeps working exactly as before.
